request.spec:
A closed period can be reopened, by a steward only (anyone else is refused with an error on the
period). Reopening makes its due-total live again: the claims in it show and total their current
figures, bound ones at their bound figure. Reopening writes PERIOD_REOPENED period=<name>.
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for the app's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
A closed period can be reopened, by a steward only (anyone else is refused with an error on the
period). Reopening makes its due-total live again: the claims in it show and total their current
figures, bound ones at their bound figure. Reopening writes PERIOD_REOPENED period=<name>.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit
records it expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as
you work; iterate until it passes. Change whatever the request needs across the app — its stored
data, its server and its front end. Do NOT edit bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop, bin/e2e,
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
A steward can now reopen a closed period, and all 4 acceptance tests pass with `bin/e2e`.

- **Server:**
  - There is a new `POST /api/sheets/{sheetId}/periods/{name}/reopen` endpoint in `PeriodController`.
  - `PeriodService.reopen` refuses anyone who isn't a steward. It also refuses a period that isn't closed. Otherwise it reopens the period and writes `PERIOD_REOPENED sheet=<id> by=<user> period=<name>` to the audit file.
  - A refused reopen changes nothing in the store and writes no audit line.
- **Data:** `Period.reopen()` marks the period open again and clears the total that was fixed when it was closed. Once that total is gone, the screen goes back to showing the period's live due-total. No database migration was needed.
- **Front end:** each period row has a Reopen button (`period-reopen`). A refused reopen shows the period's existing error message (`period-error`), which says "Only a steward can reopen a period." or "That period is not closed."

Claims needed no change: they already showed their current figures, and bound claims their bound figure. The only thing a closed period was freezing was its own total.
